title: FREE REQUEST Slightly Fanservicey Magical Girl Persona-Like - Looking for Collab

posts.author: JimmyFingus
posts.body:
Eleanor's Unnamed Magical Girl Adventures
Engine:
RPG Maker MZ
Synopsis:
In short, the plan is for the game to be Persona-like in structure. Life sim elements (social links) during the day, turn based RPG combat at night.
Plot stars Eleanor Garcia, a tremendously busty college freshman who, while dealing with the challenges of her existence (and her desire to do well in school), is thrust into the role of a magical girl by a cute talking lizard (design pending) who insists she has what it takes to put together a team to stop the Grave Threat in one year's time. She makes friends with an eccentric group of fellow college students, while also clashing with a rival team of magical girls (and boys), all while trying to make her parents proud and figure out who it is she really wants to be.
Small college town setting, set in the distant past of 2008.
While the female characters are definitely intended to be sexy (and exaggeratedly so, for some), I fully intend to stay sfw. I also intend to have plenty of sexy men and hopefully attract a diverse audience! There will be plenty of humor, but also introspection and depth for all of my characters, whatever your first impression of them may be.
Taking some inspiration from Madoka Magica for sure, but without that level of darkness. In my head, it's Madoka aesthetically, but Sailor Moon + Persona at its heart.
I'm only just beginning this project, so in any of that sounds up your alley, now's the time to make it happen!
Positions/Roles Needed:
Everything. Just looking for people to collaborate with. It's too sad to always be making things by myself.
Music: My dream scenario would be a mid-late 2000s pop punk sound for the soundtrack, but beggars can't be choosers.
Visuals: I am sticking to simple sprite work (16x16 tiles, 16x30ish characters) at the moment because it is what I have available to me (thank you itch.io asset posters), and is within my ability to make edits on. Would not be opposed to shifting directions. Similarly, I am in first person combat right now, mostly because it is easier to get looking passable than side view. In a perfect world, I'd have side view with cool animations to go with it.
Art: Currently I am commissioning a few artists to develop the cast, but I would love a more dedicated artist!
Eventing: I'm more or less comfortable with eventing, but more help is never a bad thing! Takes a long time to make a game full of dialogue and events.
Writing: I'm a writer myself, but I'm more than happy to develop with someone else.
Mapping: I'm not much of a mapper. If someone were willing to chip in here, I would certainly appreciate it.
GUI: please help me
My Role(s)/Position(s):
Writing is my forte, but I also intend to do a lot of eventing. I have some experience in other engines, so game design is not completely new to me. Obviously right now I am alone so I am also doing everything else, but I am making an effort at improving my mapping.
Skill Trade:
Writing is my big one. PM me and I'm willing to share a fanfic.
Tags:
RPG, Persona-like, life-sim
